rationale: Both pre-registered Mechanism-v3 arms failed. Arm 1 (outcome-free published zipcode grammar) ranks at chance on the decisions where it is informative. Arm N (nonlinear, all features) fails useful selection, distributed benefit, seed stability and hard harm. The measured leaky ceiling for any selector on this benchmark is +0.0218 rank gain against a 0.020 requirement, and within-decision outcome reliability is 0.239, so the gate set is unreachable by any method on this data.

arm_1_outcome_free_grammar.note: rank 0.503 is chance; the tie-breaking defect was found, fixed, and did not change the conclusion

feasibility_finding.leaky_ceiling_configuration: all 1146 feature columns, nonlinear estimator, trained on sibling mutants of the same parent in the same assay
feasibility_finding.conclusion: The blocker is benchmark measurement noise and unit count, not representation or model class.

mistakes_found.detail: grammar delta nonzero for only 3.6% of rows; comparison on all-zero decision sets measured lexical tie-breaking

mistakes_found.fixed: tested prospectively as arm N rather than retrofitted
mistakes_found.detail: leaky nonlinear recovers +0.0218 rank gain versus +0.0025 linear on identical features
